evidence.outcome: Added SafeDiagnostics redaction, bounded messages, request ids, stable application/problem+json responses, global exception/status handling, and safer startup logging.
Save Create now drains stdout/stderr concurrently, times out, kills a stuck process, bounds diagnostics, validates the generated save, and changes active save only after success.
Persisted log tail loading, safe download output, aligned SignalR timestamp payloads, and shared redaction for maintenance/server event history were added.
Frontend API parsing now handles JSON/problem details/validation/plain text and renders request ids in visible errors; live log stream failures are surfaced.
Backend tests increased to 53 passing; dotnet build and TypeScript noEmit passed.

result: Implemented the bounded observability, Save Create, and page-local error slice. Frontend Vite build remains to be verified in a writable environment.
